Ankora Lost Days is an exploration adventure where you can discover every corner of the planet of Ankora in Polly Pocket style scenarios. 

If you haven't yet experienced this adventure from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28033/Chibig_Universe_Games/]Chibig's gaming universe[/url], this is your chance to get it with a [b]60% discount during the Weeklong Deal[/b] - from February 22nd to 28th!

[previewyoutube=9c1IL4mNwXM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[b]About Ankora Lost Days[/b]

Mûn is a Junior Ranger from the Interstellar Patrol, stranded on the unexplored planet Ankora after her spaceship crashes there. Mûn will need to craft her own tools to collect the necessary resources for her adventure, overcoming many obstacles: rivers, lakes, waterfalls, mountains... and monsters.

Discover the wild planet of Ankora in a single-player survival adventure with exploration and crafting. A tale about growing up, making friends and connecting with nature.

[list]
[*] Build, modify the terrain and the bow to defend yourself!
[*] Explore a wide variety of biomes, from deserts to meadows to snowy mountains.
[*] Level up with each action. Learn new recipes and skills in order to improve your chances of surviving.
[*] Visuals inspired by Studio Ghibli films like Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind.
[*] Meet spacefaring explore Mûn as a rookie, long before the events of Deiland: Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara.
[/list]

Have you already experienced this adventure and want to explore the rest of Chibig's stories? Get the [b]Chibig Universe bundle[/b] at a reduced price and discover the rest of the adventures and connected characters.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28033/Chibig_Universe_Games/

Take advantage of these offers and continue discovering wonderful places, charming characters and opening your heart to adventures you will never forget.

notes.title: Ankora: Lost Days - V1.05 improvements and fixes
notes.content:
Hi there friends,

Thanks for playing Ankora, we have enjoyed your gameplays and support via steam forums, social shares, and reviews.

We have been working hard during the past few days and we have updated the game with a daily patch.
That's the things we have improved until now (v1.05):

- Added character names to the map.
- Show information about the stats in the Level up UI.
- Added navigation information to the menus.
- Fixed the Show Map button label in the Quest Detail UI.
- Some little fixes in the tutorial.
- Solved the bug with the North Portal.
- Remove some language placeholder text (please select one of the languages available from the main menu).
- Added volume slider for the music in the options menu.
- Added some extra prompts at the beginning to help with player guidance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/d2e20208455c19fd27cea3357f57c28c06cdba18.png[/img]

We are really committed to improving your experience with Ankora: Lost Days. Please, let us know your thoughts, bug reporting, and suggestion in the forum channels. 

Best regards,
Chibig team
